stem: Geodesy is the science which deals with –

options.label: c
options.text: Measurement of elevation and depression of the earth

options.label: d
options.text: Recording of changes made by the crust

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above/More than one of the above

expl: Geodesy is the science of accurately measuring and understanding three fundamental properties of the Earth. These properties are—Earth’s geometric shape, the Earth’s orientation in space, and the Earth’s gravitational field. Along with this, it also studies changes in the above properties over time. Thus, geodesy is the science related to the measurement of the Earth’s dimensions.

stem: Stalactite and stalagmite landforms are formed by-

options.label: d
options.text: More than one of the above

expl: Stalactite and stalagmite landforms are formed by underground water. Stalactites are hanging, icicle-like pillars of varying thickness. Generally, they occur near the base or near the roof of a cave and become thinner towards the tip. They appear in many shapes. Stalagmites grow upward from the cave floor. In fact, stalagmites are formed by lime-mixed water dripping from the cave roof onto the ground, or they form in the shape of thin pipes directly below stalactites.

stem: About half of the total number of large dams in the world are in which country?

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above/More than one of the above

expl: According to the International Commission on Large Dams, about 40 percent of the total large dams in the world are located in China (23,841 dams). In some cases, dams with a height between 5 and 15 metres are also classified as large dams based on storage capacity criteria.

expl: In the Mediterranean climate, most rainfall occurs during winter. Equatorial regions receive convective rainfall accompanied by afternoon thunderstorms throughout the year. Monsoon regions receive most of their rainfall during summer due to monsoon winds. Desert regions experience very little or highly irregular rainfall. Hence, option (b) is the correct match.

stem: Dalmatian Coast is
expl: The Dalmatian Coast, one of the most rugged coastlines in the world, is mainly located along the Adriatic Sea in Croatia (Southern Europe). It is an example of a karstic piedmont coast. Karst landforms have developed here. According to NASA, this distinctive coastal landform was formed due to faulting caused by tectonic activity after the end of the Ice Age, along with a rise in sea level.

stem: “Golden Triangle” refers to—

options.label: c
options.text: T he drug-producing region of Thailand, Myanmar, etc.

options.label: d

expl: The Golden Triangle is a mountainous region of Southeast Asia, where the borders of Thailand, Laos, and Myanmar meet near the confluence of the Mekong and Ruak rivers. This region has long been associated with drug gangs and the illegal cultivation and trade of opium. The name “Golden Triangle” was given in 1971 by U.S. Deputy Secretary of State Marshall Green.
